items.title: Album Of The Week: Lily Seabird Lightspheres On Their Way
items.summary: You’re probably wondering, “What’s a lightsphere?” Lily Seabird, who invented the term when she titled her new album Lightspheres On Your Way , defines a lightsphere as a catalyzing presence that perennially returns to alter life’s trajectory. “A lightsphere can be so many things,” she says in promo materials, “an actual light like a star, the sun, a UFO; headlights, a flashlight in the night; but also life, living things, people, relationships.” It could even be a Lily Seabird album. items.title: Death Valley Girls – “Basic Witch”
items.summary: Bonnie Bloomgarden, leader of the consistently great Los Angeles psychedelic rockers Death Valley Girls, recently lost her Altadena home in the California wildfires. That loss, along with the death of her dog Tommy, informed Death Valley Girls' upcoming album Welcome To Earth . We already posted the excellent lead single " Message From The Venus Flower ." Their new song is a bright, emotional synth-garage bop about realizing how happy you are to have someone out of your life. items.title: Oso Oso Announce New Album an exchange of information: Hear “know you know me better”
items.summary: We are oh so back. Long Island treasure Jade Lilitri is back today with news of the next Oso Oso album, an exchange of information . It's coming out in November on Feral Twin, the new label started by Hop Along drummer Mark Quinlan. Lead single "know you know me better," out now, kicks off with a surprise string arrangement that may or may not be synthetic. But the song is, at its core, exactly the sort of pristine emo-tinged guitar-pop tune Lilitri has specialized in for years.
